decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the core offer, kept a page of its own in both years and fits the data-driven strategy, so performance appears to meet aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search.

The apron connectivity module rose from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment and an integrating role in the digital portfolio that slack in a broad R&D-active firm can carry.

Revenue calculation and billing software is a bit farther from the operational core, but its promotion to a dedicated page suggests results near aspiration and support for the expanding software services strategy.
Apron equipment monitoring builds on the large installed equipment base and supports lifecycle services, and its 2024 promotion to a dedicated page indicates the product is meeting expectations.
